name: nolane-video-command-center
description: The single AI-first front door for Nolane video production. Bundles 23 integrated skills for storytelling, shot design, motion, 3D/VFX, Manim, AI media, audio/speech, captions, editorial interchange, toolchain automation, licensing and evidence-based QA.

interface.longDescription: Use one private plugin to route internally across 23 bundled expert skills: direction, story, shot design, motion, Manim, 3D/VFX, AI media, voice/audio, speech alignment, captions, editorial timelines, scene analysis, tool installation, license checks and production QA. Works with Nolane-x/video and connected GitHub tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create, continue or improve my video using the Nolane video production system. Select the best included skills and tools, respect the separate asset-library workstream, work safely on GitHub, render a candidate and verify it before handoff.
